recap.paragraph: Drew Lock tossed 2 touchdown passes as the Seahawks beat the Raiders 21-13! In Las Vegas, Fernando Mendoza ran 10 yards for a Raiders touchdown. Lock then zipped a 34-yard touchdown pass to Cooper Kupp. Jadarian Price ran for a touchdown in the third quarter. Lock struck again with a spectacular 71-yard touchdown pass to Jaxon Smith-Njigba! The defending Super Bowl champs moved to 6-4, while the Raiders fell to 4-6.
